newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Auchan hopes to open more hypers in Portugal-paper.
newsitem.headline: Auchan hopes to open more hypers in Portugal-paper.

text.p: French group Auchan, which bought Portuguese retailer Pao de Acucar last year, hopes to open seven hypermarkets in Portugal in the next five years, but expects the government to approve just four, a Lisbon newspaper reported.
"We expect the Portuguese government to approve just four of the seven shops," Diario Economico quoted Francis Leputre, head of Auchan's Iberian operations, as saying.
The paper said that Auchan's ambition to open seven more hypermarkets over the next five years would raise to 15 the total number of hypermarkets it operated in Portugal.
Family-owned Auchan bought a 68 percent stake in Pao de Acucar, Portugal's third largest retailer, from Portuguese automotives-to-agriculture group Entreposto last July.
